tools.name: find_cheapest_vps
tools.description: VPS plans that meet the given minimums, cheapest first by average monthly cost over 24 months with renewals (estimated where the provider doesn't publish them). Supports Linux (default) and Windows VPS plans, NVMe, unlimited bandwidth, location and monthly billing filters. Prices are list prices in

tools.name: get_provider_plans
tools.description: Every VPS plan we track from one provider, with list price, billing term, renewal price, specs and data centers.

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of any two tracked VPS providers: verdict, entry prices, median cost per GB of RAM and per vCPU, cheapest plan at each RAM size (1 to 32 GB) and server countries.

tools.name: recommend_vps_for_use_case
tools.description: Minimum and recommended VPS specs plus the lowest 2-year cost pick and runner-up for a specific use case (e.g. wordpress, docker, n8n, coolify, supabase, minecraft, palworld, nextcloud, openclaw, ai-agents).

tools.name: price_changes
tools.description: VPS price increases and cuts recorded on the providers' own pricing pages, newest first.

tools.name: vps_price_index
tools.description: Market numbers: median price per GB of RAM and per vCPU, per provider, plus this quarter's findings on renewal increases and prepaid terms, each as one quotable sentence.
